items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: I played Walt before he got nuts right.

ctx.x: Oh no, I know Walter Deku.
Walter Deku, yeah. Yeah, I guess he was with him. I played Walt before he got nuts right.
Yeah, I remember he had that trouble. Mm-hm. He's still around town but I haven't seen him before. Was Walter Deco? Walter Deco, yeah. I played Walter before he got nuts, I had to stop playing.
